summary.en: Search and manage Jira, Confluence, and Loom

description.zh:
通过 Atlassian Rovo MCP 搜索、创建和管理 Jira、Confluence、Loom 等工作内容。
首次连接需使用 Atlassian 账号完成 OAuth 授权。
description.en:
Search, create, and manage Jira issues, Confluence pages, Loom videos, and more via Atlassian Rovo MCP.
Sign in with your Atlassian account to authorize on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Atlassian 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Atlassian in the browser and authorize on first connect.
